blocks.arabic_text: الْمَاءِ، قَالَ زَكَرِيَّا: قَالَ مُصْعَبٌ: وَنَسِيتُ الْعَاشِرَةَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب خصال الفطرة رقم:٦٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Ten things are from the way of the Prophets: trimming the moustache, growing the beard, doing miswak (cleaning the teeth), drawing water into the nose and cleaning it, cutting the nails, carefully washing the joints of the fingers (and likewise the places on the body where dirt collects, for example the ears and the nostrils), plucking the hair under the armpits, shaving the hair below the navel, and cleaning with water after relieving oneself.” The narrator of the hadith, Hazrat Mus'ab (RH), says, “I have forgotten what the tenth thing among these is; I think the tenth thing would be rinsing the mouth.'

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلسِّوَاكُ مَطْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ مَرْضَاةٌ للِرَّبِّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب الترغيب في السواك رقم:٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “The miswak (tooth-cleaning stick) purifies the mouth. Moreover, it is a means of Allah's pleasure.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا جَاءَنِي جِبْرِيلُ ﵇ قَطُّ إِلَّا أَمَرَنِي بِالسِّوَاكِ، لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ أُحْفِيَ مُقَدَّمَ فِيَّ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whenever Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) came to me, he would emphasise doing miswak. I kept doing miswak so much that I feared that, by doing miswak excessively, I would injure my gums
